minutes_text:
OLD TOWN LA VERNE BUSINESS IMPROVEMENT DISTIRICT
  MINUTES OF THE RBGULAR MEETING
  Monday, January 6,2020

l.  The meeting was called to order by Chairperson Craig Walters at 8:32 a.m.

  Advisory Board Members present: Craig Walters, Chris Gendreau, Micky Rehm, Jason
  Miller and Matt Forgey. Advisory Board Members absent: Marianne Stark. City
  Representatives present: Community Development Director Eric Scherer and
  Administrative Clerk Natalie Hiatt.

2  APPROVAL  F MINUTES - December 2,2019

  It was moved by Chairperson Chris Gendreau and seconded by Micky Rehm to approve
  the minutes of the December 2,2019 meeting as submitted. Motion carried by a 5-0 vote

3.  CALENDAR

  Mr. Gendreau announced the sub-committee for the SGV Open Street Event is scheduled
  to meet at Chase's on Wednesday, January 8that 10:00 a'm.

4.  NEW B SINESS

  A. Holiday Stroll Recap - Ms. Rehm stated that Santa Claus was moved indoors and
  the band did not perform due to the weather.

  Mr. Forgey suggested a business decorating contest to encourage participation next
  year.

  Ms. Rehm stated the decorations are removed by Public Works the Monday after
  New Year's Day.

5.  CONTINUED BUSINESS

  A. Annual Meeting - Mr. Scherer announced the EDR off The Spot Caf6 at Citrus Hall
  was secured for the Annual Meeting. Invitations are being sent to the 6 City Council
  Candidates and 3 Mayoral Candidates. The meeting will include a candidate
  introduction, Tax Measure presentation by City Manager Bob Russi, and a University
  of La Verne presentation by Jason Miller. Additional updates will be provided for the
  Gold Line project, phase-two tree lights, and SGV Open Street Event.
 6,  COMMITTEE REPORTSruPDATES

  City Report - Eric Scherer

  Mr. Scherer stated the City is hosting a Candidate's Forum on February 13th at the
  Community Center.

  University of La Verne Report - Jason Miller

  None

  Marketing - Micky Rehm

  Mr. Gendreau stated that Mr. Kostuma approached him with an opportunity to advertise
  in Magazine of Values.

  Ms. Rehm stated the spring mailing will include an advertisement for Wine Walk. She
  also received a quote from Active Signs for pole banners at $95.O0/each including
  hardware.

  Mr. Walters suggested scheduling a marketing meeting to discuss the year. The meeting
  was scheduled for Wednesday, January l5th 8:30 a.m. at Micky's Jewelry Studio.

  Chamber of Commerce Report - Leah Skinner

  Ms. Skinner announced upcoming events. The Chamber is hosting the Excellence of La
  Verne Business Awards on Januiry 22"d at Sierra La Verne Country Club. Hillcrest is
  hosting an ADA presentation on February 1lth at 7:30 a.m'

  Ms. Skinner's administrative assistant resigned. Julie Griffith, previously with David and
  Margaret, will be joining the Chamber of Commerce staff.

  Social Media Update - MickY Rehm

  None

  Financial Report -

  Mr. Scherer stated the six month figures will be released by the end of January.

  Mr. Walters called for volunteers to form a Budget Committee. Mr. Gendreau, Ms.
  Rehm, and Mr. Walters volunteered.
 7.  PUBLIC COMMENT (Any discussion or action on non-agendized items must be
  deferred to the following meeting, as required by California Brown Act Law)

  None

8.  ADJOURNMENT

  Meeting was adjourned at 9:04 a.m., the next regular meeting to be held on Monday,
  February 3'd at 8:00 a.m.
